sn45.77:1.2: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekadhammaṃpi samanupassāmi yena anuppanno vā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo uppajjati uppanno vā ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchati. yathayidaṃ bhikkhave kalyāṇamittatā.
sn45.77:1.3: kalyāṇamittassetaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhuno pāṭikaṅkhaṃ ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāvessati ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarissatīti.
sn45.77:1.4: kathañca bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkaroti.
sn45.77:1.5: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ. pe. sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn45.77:1.6: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu kalyāṇamitto ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bhāveti ariyaṃ aṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ bahulīkarotīti.
